<!-- Author: Kunru Song -->

This report draws the accepted S5.3 raw-p sparse temporal,
contemporaneous, and between-person networks. All graph geometry, edges,
arrows, and nodes are rendered natively by `qgraph`; `ggplot2` is not used to
reconstruct the network. Edge-weight text is deliberately omitted from every
network figure and is moved to a three-sheet adjacency-matrix workbook. The
primary Temporal figure omits autoregressive self-loops to distinguish cross-lagged associations;
a companion Temporal figure retains all supported autoregressive effects.
The primary
Temporal, contemporaneous, and between-person figures use the same fixed node coordinates, node order, and styling. Positive edges are orange-red and
negative edges are sky blue. Every displayed edge has the same moderate line
width. Absolute edge-weight magnitude is encoded only by transparency within
each visible network: the strongest edge is fully opaque and the weakest edge
has transparency 0.75, with linear interpolation between those endpoints.
All nodes are circles. Their outer qgraph rings display temporal nodewise R2
for the Temporal variants and maximum-scaled full-network strength for the
contemporaneous and between-person networks.
Full unthresholded results remain in S5.3.
Because no multiplicity correction is applied, these `p < .05` display
networks are exploratory summaries of the unregularized mlVAR.

The adjacency workbook reports every full-precision-derived edge weight to
three decimals and appends `*` for `.01 <= p < .05`, `**` for
`.001 <= p < .01`, and `***` for `p < .001`. Three companion heatmaps use
within-network color intensity for supported edge magnitude: red for positive,
blue for negative, and pure white for nonsignificant cells. Heatmap cells have
no text. Their row and column order is `E1`-`E3`, `P1`-`P6`, and `D1`-`D3`.

All three distinct qgraph 1.9.8 built-in layouts (`circle`, `groups`, and
`spring`) are rendered for the no-autoregression Temporal network. Visual
inspection retains `spring`, and those Temporal-derived coordinates are frozen
and reused unchanged for every final network figure.

# Load accepted nodes, layout, and raw-p sparse networks

```{r load-upstream}
dat_step5_mlvar <- load_single_object(data_file, "dat_step5_mlvar")
fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar <- load_single_object(
  fit_file, "fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar"
)
results_s5_3_mlvar_networks <- load_single_object(
  result_input_file, "results_s5_3_mlvar_networks"
)

node_map <- dat_step5_mlvar$node_map
node_names <- node_map$node
layout_data <- dat_step5_mlvar$layout |>
  dplyr::left_join(node_map, by = "node") |>
  dplyr::arrange(order) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    original_x = x,
    original_y = y,
    visual_label = c(
      paste0("E", 1:3), paste0("P", 1:6), paste0("D", 1:3)
    ),
    display_group = dplyr::case_when(
      community == "Engagement Time" ~ "Engagement Time",
      subgroup == "Peripheral" ~ "Peripheral PSMU",
      subgroup == "Core" ~ "Core PSMU",
      community == "Distress" ~ "Distress"
    )
  )

sparse_matrices <- results_s5_3_mlvar_networks$sparse_matrices
full_matrices <- results_s5_3_mlvar_networks$full_matrices[c(
  "temporal", "contemporaneous", "between"
)]
edge_tables <- results_s5_3_mlvar_networks$edge_tables

temporal_no_ar <- sparse_matrices$temporal
diag(temporal_no_ar) <- 0

model_data <- fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$data
model_residuals <- fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$step1_residuals
stopifnot(
  nrow(model_data) == nrow(model_residuals),
  all(node_names %in% names(model_data)),
  all(node_names %in% names(model_residuals)),
  "Name_ID" %in% names(model_data)
)

temporal_r2 <- vapply(node_names, function(node) {
  outcome <- model_data[[node]]
  residual <- model_residuals[[node]]
  person_mean <- ave(
    outcome, model_data$Name_ID,
    FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  centered_outcome <- outcome - person_mean
  1 - sum(residual^2, na.rm = TRUE) /
    sum(centered_outcome^2, na.rm = TRUE)
}, numeric(1))

full_strength <- function(matrix) {
  matrix <- matrix[node_names, node_names, drop = FALSE]
  diag(matrix) <- 0
  rowSums(abs(matrix))
}

contemporaneous_strength <- full_strength(full_matrices$contemporaneous)
between_strength <- full_strength(full_matrices$between)

node_indicator_values <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    network = "Temporal", node = node_names,
    metric = "Temporal nodewise R2",
    raw_value = temporal_r2,
    display_fraction = temporal_r2,
    scaling = "Raw 0-1 R2",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  data.frame(
    network = "Contemporaneous", node = node_names,
    metric = "Full-network strength",
    raw_value = contemporaneous_strength,
    display_fraction = contemporaneous_strength /
      max(contemporaneous_strength),
    scaling = "Strength divided by within-network maximum",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  data.frame(
    network = "Between", node = node_names,
    metric = "Full-network strength",
    raw_value = between_strength,
    display_fraction = between_strength / max(between_strength),
    scaling = "Strength divided by within-network maximum",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)

make_p_matrix <- function(network) {
  p_matrix <- matrix(
    NA_real_, nrow = length(node_names), ncol = length(node_names),
    dimnames = list(node_names, node_names)
  )
  if (network == "temporal") {
    edges <- edge_tables$temporal
    p_matrix[cbind(match(edges$from, node_names), match(edges$to, node_names))] <-
      edges$p
  } else {
    edges <- edge_tables[[network]]
    positions_12 <- cbind(
      match(edges$node1, node_names), match(edges$node2, node_names)
    )
    positions_21 <- positions_12[, 2:1, drop = FALSE]
    p_matrix[positions_12] <- edges$p_and
    p_matrix[positions_21] <- edges$p_and
  }
  p_matrix
}

p_matrices <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(c("temporal", "contemporaneous", "between"), make_p_matrix),
  c("temporal", "contemporaneous", "between")
)

stopifnot(
  identical(layout_data$node, node_names),
  all(vapply(sparse_matrices, function(matrix) {
    identical(rownames(matrix), node_names) && identical(colnames(matrix), node_names)
  }, logical(1))),
  all(edge_tables$temporal$supported_p05 ==
    (is.finite(edge_tables$temporal$p) & edge_tables$temporal$p < .05)),
  all(edge_tables$contemporaneous$supported_p05 ==
    (is.finite(edge_tables$contemporaneous$p_and) &
      edge_tables$contemporaneous$p_and < .05)),
  all(edge_tables$between$supported_p05 ==
    (is.finite(edge_tables$between$p_and) & edge_tables$between$p_and < .05)),
  all(vapply(full_matrices, function(matrix) {
    identical(rownames(matrix), node_names) && identical(colnames(matrix), node_names)
  }, logical(1))),
  all(is.finite(p_matrices$temporal)),
  all(is.finite(p_matrices$contemporaneous[upper.tri(p_matrices$contemporaneous)])),
  all(is.finite(p_matrices$between[upper.tri(p_matrices$between)])),
  all(diag(temporal_no_ar) == 0),
  nrow(node_indicator_values) == 36L,
  all(is.finite(node_indicator_values$raw_value)),
  all(node_indicator_values$display_fraction >= 0 &
    node_indicator_values$display_fraction <= 1),
  identical(
    node_indicator_values$node[node_indicator_values$network == "Temporal"],
    node_names
  )
)

knitr::kable(layout_data[c(
  "order", "node", "visual_label", "short_label", "community", "subgroup"
)])
knitr::kable(node_indicator_values, digits = 3)
```

# qgraph-native rendering specification

The node fill encodes the three network communities. Within the single PSMU
community, Peripheral and Core manifestations retain distinct border colors;
this does not redefine them as separate communities. Nodes are equal-diameter
circles. Their qgraph pie borders form outer indicator rings: raw temporal R2
for both Temporal variants and full-network strength divided by the respective
network maximum for the two undirected networks. Every edge uses the same
moderate line width. Within each visible network, absolute weight is mapped
linearly to transparency from 0 for the strongest edge to 0.75 for the weakest
edge; line width does not encode weight.

```{r qgraph-specification}
positive_color <- "#E64B35"
negative_color <- "#4DBBD5"
constant_edge_width <- 1.4
maximum_edge_transparency <- 0.75
individual_canvas <- c(width = 11.5, height = 9.5)
combined_canvas <- c(width = 15.6, height = 6.0)
heatmap_canvas <- c(width = 9.0, height = 7.8)
individual_node_size <- 5.2
combined_node_size <- 5.2
individual_temporal_arrow_size <- 2.0
combined_temporal_arrow_size <- 3.0
temporal_edge_curve <- 0.35
temporal_curve_all <- TRUE
node_ring_fill <- "#3D3D3D"
node_ring_remainder <- "#E6E6E6"
node_ring_border_fraction <- 0.20

render_profile_audit <- data.frame(
  profile = c("Individual network", "Three-network combined"),
  canvas_width_inches = c(
    individual_canvas[["width"]], combined_canvas[["width"]]
  ),
  canvas_height_inches = c(
    individual_canvas[["height"]], combined_canvas[["height"]]
  ),
  node_size = c(individual_node_size, combined_node_size),
  node_label_cex = c(0.80, 0.82),
  temporal_arrow_size = c(
    individual_temporal_arrow_size, combined_temporal_arrow_size
  ),
  temporal_edge_curve = temporal_edge_curve,
  curve_all_temporal_edges = temporal_curve_all,
  title_cex = c(1.15, 1.05),
  subtitle_cex = c(0.74, 0.68),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
node_fill <- unname(c(
  "Engagement Time" = "#F3C677", "PSMU" = "#B69AE8", "Distress" = "#82D992"
)[layout_data$community])
node_border <- dplyr::case_when(
  layout_data$community == "Engagement Time" ~ "#8C6714",
  layout_data$subgroup == "Peripheral" ~ "#8A4DB3",
  layout_data$subgroup == "Core" ~ "#4B1973",
  layout_data$community == "Distress" ~ "#216E3A"
)
groups <- list(
  "Engagement Time" = which(layout_data$community == "Engagement Time"),
  "PSMU" = which(layout_data$community == "PSMU"),
  "Distress" = which(layout_data$community == "Distress")
)

edge_transparency_matrix <- function(matrix) {
  transparency <- matrix(
    NA_real_, nrow(matrix), ncol(matrix), dimnames = dimnames(matrix)
  )
  displayed <- is.finite(matrix) & matrix != 0
  if (!any(displayed)) return(transparency)

  magnitudes <- abs(matrix[displayed])
  magnitude_range <- range(magnitudes)
  if (diff(magnitude_range) <= sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)) {
    transparency[displayed] <- 0
  } else {
    transparency[displayed] <- maximum_edge_transparency *
      (magnitude_range[2L] - magnitudes) / diff(magnitude_range)
  }
  transparency
}

edge_color_matrix <- function(matrix) {
  transparency <- edge_transparency_matrix(matrix)
  colors <- matrix(
    NA_character_, nrow(matrix), ncol(matrix), dimnames = dimnames(matrix)
  )
  displayed <- is.finite(matrix) & matrix != 0
  base_colors <- ifelse(matrix[displayed] > 0, positive_color, negative_color)
  rgb_values <- grDevices::col2rgb(base_colors) / 255
  colors[displayed] <- grDevices::rgb(
    rgb_values[1L, ], rgb_values[2L, ], rgb_values[3L, ],
    alpha = 1 - transparency[displayed]
  )
  colors
}

node_indicator_fraction <- function(network) {
  values <- node_indicator_values |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$network == .env$network) |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(.data$node, node_names)) |>
    dplyr::pull(.data$display_fraction)
  stopifnot(length(values) == length(node_names), all(is.finite(values)))
  values
}

network_specifications <- list(
  Temporal = list(
    matrix = temporal_no_ar,
    directed = TRUE,
    diag = FALSE,
    autoregression_visible = FALSE,
    node_indicator_network = "Temporal",
    node_indicator = node_indicator_fraction("Temporal"),
    node_indicator_label = "outer ring = temporal R2",
    title = "Temporal network (autoregression omitted)",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Curved directed cross-lagged coefficients; unadjusted p < .05;",
      "opacity encodes |weight|; outer ring = temporal R2"
    )
  ),
  TemporalWithAR = list(
    matrix = sparse_matrices$temporal,
    directed = TRUE,
    diag = TRUE,
    autoregression_visible = TRUE,
    node_indicator_network = "Temporal",
    node_indicator = node_indicator_fraction("Temporal"),
    node_indicator_label = "outer ring = temporal R2",
    title = "Temporal network (autoregression shown)",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Curved directed lag-1 coefficients and self-loops; unadjusted p < .05;",
      "opacity encodes |weight|; outer ring = temporal R2"
    )
  ),
  Contemporaneous = list(
    matrix = sparse_matrices$contemporaneous,
    directed = FALSE,
    diag = FALSE,
    autoregression_visible = NA,
    node_indicator_network = "Contemporaneous",
    node_indicator = node_indicator_fraction("Contemporaneous"),
    node_indicator_label = "outer ring = full strength / maximum",
    title = "Contemporaneous network",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Residual partial correlations; AND rule; unadjusted p < .05;",
      "opacity encodes |weight|; outer ring = full strength / maximum"
    )
  ),
  Between = list(
    matrix = sparse_matrices$between,
    directed = FALSE,
    diag = FALSE,
    autoregression_visible = NA,
    node_indicator_network = "Between",
    node_indicator = node_indicator_fraction("Between"),
    node_indicator_label = "outer ring = full strength / maximum",
    title = "Between-person network",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Person-level partial correlations; AND rule; unadjusted p < .05;",
      "opacity encodes |weight|; outer ring = full strength / maximum"
    )
  )
)

qgraph_builtin_layouts <- c("circle", "groups", "spring")
layout_seeds <- stats::setNames(526400L + seq_along(qgraph_builtin_layouts), qgraph_builtin_layouts)

derive_builtin_layout <- function(layout_name) {
  set.seed(layout_seeds[[layout_name]])
  graph <- qgraph::qgraph(
    network_specifications$Temporal$matrix,
    layout = layout_name,
    groups = groups,
    labels = layout_data$visual_label,
    directed = TRUE,
    diag = FALSE,
    DoNotPlot = TRUE,
    minimum = 0,
    cut = 0,
    fade = FALSE,
    layoutRound = TRUE
  )
  coordinates <- graph$layout
  rownames(coordinates) <- node_names
  coordinates
}

candidate_layouts <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(qgraph_builtin_layouts, derive_builtin_layout),
  qgraph_builtin_layouts
)

# Retain the previously selected layout; the candidate SVGs document that choice.
selected_layout_algorithm <- "spring"
layout_matrix <- candidate_layouts[[selected_layout_algorithm]]
rownames(layout_matrix) <- node_names
layout_data$x <- layout_matrix[, 1L]
layout_data$y <- layout_matrix[, 2L]

qgraph_call <- function(
  specification, layout_override = layout_matrix,
  do_not_plot = FALSE, compact = FALSE
) {
  maximum <- max(abs(specification$matrix))
  if (!is.finite(maximum) || maximum <= 0) maximum <- 1
  node_size <- if (compact) combined_node_size else individual_node_size
  qgraph::qgraph(
    specification$matrix,
    layout = layout_override,
    groups = groups,
    labels = layout_data$visual_label,
    directed = specification$directed,
    diag = specification$diag,
    weighted = FALSE,
    DoNotPlot = do_not_plot,
    color = node_fill,
    border.color = node_border,
    border.width = 2.2,
    shape = "circle",
    vsize = node_size,
    vsize2 = node_size,
    pie = specification$node_indicator,
    pieBorder = node_ring_border_fraction,
    pieColor = node_ring_fill,
    pieColor2 = node_ring_remainder,
    pieStart = 0.25,
    label.cex = if (compact) 0.82 else 0.80,
    label.color = "#202020",
    label.scale = TRUE,
    edge.color = edge_color_matrix(specification$matrix),
    edge.labels = FALSE,
    edge.width = 1,
    esize = constant_edge_width,
    asize = if (specification$directed) {
      if (compact) combined_temporal_arrow_size else
        individual_temporal_arrow_size
    } else {
      0
    },
    loop = if (isTRUE(specification$autoregression_visible)) 0.55 else 1,
    maximum = maximum,
    minimum = 0,
    cut = 0,
    fade = FALSE,
    trans = FALSE,
    negDashed = FALSE,
    curve = if (specification$directed) temporal_edge_curve else 0,
    curveAll = specification$directed && temporal_curve_all,
    legend = FALSE,
    rescale = TRUE,
    layoutScale = if (compact) c(0.88, 0.80) else c(0.84, 0.78),
    mar = if (compact) c(3.2, 1.2, 4.0, 1.2) else c(4.2, 2.5, 5.0, 2.5),
    title = specification$title,
    title.cex = if (compact) 1.05 else 1.15,
    title.color = "#202020"
  )
}

qgraph_objects <- lapply(
  network_specifications, qgraph_call,
  layout_override = layout_matrix, do_not_plot = TRUE
)

extract_qgraph_transparency <- function(graph) {
  1 - grDevices::col2rgb(
    graph$graphAttributes$Edges$color, alpha = TRUE
  )[4L, ] / 255
}

edge_encoding_audit <- lapply(names(qgraph_objects), function(network) {
  graph <- qgraph_objects[[network]]
  widths <- graph$graphAttributes$Edges$width
  transparency <- extract_qgraph_transparency(graph)
  magnitudes <- abs(graph$Edgelist$weight)
  magnitude_order <- order(magnitudes)
  data.frame(
    network = network,
    displayed_edges = length(widths),
    minimum_edge_width = min(widths),
    maximum_edge_width = max(widths),
    minimum_transparency = min(transparency),
    maximum_transparency = max(transparency),
    strongest_edge_transparency = max(transparency[
      magnitudes == max(magnitudes)
    ]),
    weakest_edge_transparency = min(transparency[
      magnitudes == min(magnitudes)
    ]),
    transparency_monotonic = all(
      diff(transparency[magnitude_order]) <= 1 / 255 + 1e-10
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

node_indicator_audit <- lapply(names(qgraph_objects), function(network) {
  graph <- qgraph_objects[[network]]
  specification <- network_specifications[[network]]
  node_attributes <- graph$graphAttributes$Nodes
  metric_rows <- node_indicator_values |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$network == specification$node_indicator_network
    )
  data.frame(
    network = network,
    node_shape = paste(unique(node_attributes$shape), collapse = ", "),
    equal_width_height = all(abs(
      node_attributes$width - node_attributes$height
    ) < 1e-10),
    node_width = unique(node_attributes$width)[1L],
    node_height = unique(node_attributes$height)[1L],
    ring_metric = unique(metric_rows$metric),
    ring_scaling = unique(metric_rows$scaling),
    raw_minimum = min(metric_rows$raw_value),
    raw_maximum = max(metric_rows$raw_value),
    display_fraction_minimum = min(node_attributes$pie),
    display_fraction_maximum = max(node_attributes$pie),
    qgraph_pie_matches_specification = isTRUE(all.equal(
      node_attributes$pie, specification$node_indicator,
      tolerance = 1e-12
    )),
    ring_border_fraction = unique(node_attributes$pieBorder)[1L],
    ring_fill = paste(unique(node_attributes$pieColor), collapse = ", "),
    ring_remainder = paste(unique(node_attributes$pieColor2), collapse = ", "),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

qgraph_audit <- data.frame(
  network = names(qgraph_objects),
  object_class = vapply(qgraph_objects, function(x) class(x)[[1L]], character(1)),
  graph_engine = "qgraph native base graphics",
  layout_algorithm = selected_layout_algorithm,
  identical_layout = TRUE,
  autoregression_visible = vapply(
    network_specifications,
    function(x) if (is.na(x$autoregression_visible)) NA else x$autoregression_visible,
    logical(1)
  ),
  arrow_size = vapply(
    network_specifications,
    function(x) if (x$directed) individual_temporal_arrow_size else NA_real_,
    numeric(1)
  ),
  combined_temporal_arrow_size = vapply(
    network_specifications,
    function(x) if (x$directed) combined_temporal_arrow_size else NA_real_,
    numeric(1)
  ),

    qgraph_objects,
    function(x) min(abs(x$graphAttributes$Edges$curve)),
    numeric(1)
  ),
  actual_maximum_abs_curve = vapply(
    qgraph_objects,
    function(x) max(abs(x$graphAttributes$Edges$curve)),
    numeric(1)
  ),
  edge_width_rule = "constant",
  requested_edge_width = constant_edge_width,
  weight_encoding = "within-network linear transparency",
  strongest_edge_target_transparency = 0,
  weakest_edge_target_transparency = maximum_edge_transparency,
  qgraph_weighted_width_scaling = FALSE,
  node_shape = "circle",

    network_specifications, `[[`, character(1), "node_indicator_label"
  ),
  edge_weight_labels = FALSE,
  ggplot_network_geometry = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

# Compare Temporal layouts and generate the fixed-layout network variants

The SVG device is opened by `svglite`, after which `qgraph` draws directly to
that device. The report embeds these SVG files directly.

```{r generate-figures, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
draw_one_network <- function(
  specification, layout_override = layout_matrix, compact = FALSE
) {
  graph <- qgraph_call(
    specification, layout_override = layout_override,
    do_not_plot = FALSE, compact = compact
  )
  subtitle <- if (!compact) {
    specification$subtitle
  } else if (specification$directed) {
    "Raw p < .05; curved arrows; ring = temporal R2"
  } else {
    "Raw p < .05 (AND); ring = relative full strength"
  }
  graphics::mtext(
    subtitle, side = 1, line = 1.0,
    cex = if (compact) 0.68 else 0.74, col = "#4A4A4A"
  )
  invisible(graph)
}

save_native_qgraph <- function(
  path, specification, width, height,
  layout_override = layout_matrix
) {
  svglite::svglite(path, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)
  draw_one_network(specification, layout_override = layout_override)
  invisible(path)
}

save_native_combined <- function(path) {
  svglite::svglite(
    path, width = combined_canvas[["width"]],
    height = combined_canvas[["height"]], bg = "white"
  )
  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)
  old_parameters <- graphics::par(mfrow = c(1, 3), oma = c(1.6, 0, 0, 0))
  on.exit(graphics::par(old_parameters), add = TRUE, after = FALSE)
  for (specification in network_specifications[c(
    "Temporal", "Contemporaneous", "Between"
  )]) {
    draw_one_network(
      specification, layout_override = layout_matrix, compact = TRUE
    )
  }
  graphics::mtext(
    paste(
      "Identical coordinates; Temporal self-loops omitted; edge opacity =",
      "|weight|; strength rings are scaled within network"
    ),
    side = 1, outer = TRUE, line = 0.15, cex = 0.72, col = "#404040"
  )
  invisible(path)
}

for (layout_name in qgraph_builtin_layouts) {
  candidate_specification <- network_specifications$Temporal
  candidate_specification$title <- paste0(
    "Temporal network - ", layout_name, " layout"
  )
  save_native_qgraph(
    layout_candidate_files[[layout_name]], candidate_specification,
    width = individual_canvas[["width"]],
    height = individual_canvas[["height"]],
    layout_override = candidate_layouts[[layout_name]]
  )
}
```

# Edge-weight adjacency tables

The workbook uses the full unthresholded S5.3 matrices rather than replacing
nonsignificant estimates with zero. Significance stars use the same raw-p rule
as the sparse figures. For Temporal, rows are source nodes at `t-1` and columns
are outcome nodes at `t`. The two undirected matrices are symmetric. Their
diagonals use `N/A` because no self-edge is defined.

```{r adjacency-tables}
visual_labels <- layout_data$visual_label

significance_stars <- function(p) {
  stars <- matrix("", nrow(p), ncol(p), dimnames = dimnames(p))
  stars[is.finite(p) & p >= .01 & p < .05] <- "*"
  stars[is.finite(p) & p >= .001 & p < .01] <- "**"
  stars[is.finite(p) & p < .001] <- "***"
  stars
}

format_adjacency_matrix <- function(weight, p, diagonal_defined) {
  stars <- significance_stars(p)
  display_weight <- weight
  display_weight[abs(display_weight) < .0005] <- 0
  formatted <- matrix(
    sprintf("%.3f", as.vector(display_weight)),
    nrow = nrow(weight), ncol = ncol(weight), dimnames = dimnames(weight)
  )
  formatted[is.finite(p)] <- paste0(
    formatted[is.finite(p)], stars[is.finite(p)]
  )
  formatted[!is.finite(p)] <- ""
  if (!diagonal_defined) diag(formatted) <- "N/A"
  dimnames(formatted) <- list(visual_labels, visual_labels)
  formatted
}

star_matrices <- lapply(p_matrices, significance_stars)
formatted_adjacency_matrices <- list(
  Temporal = format_adjacency_matrix(
    full_matrices$temporal, p_matrices$temporal, diagonal_defined = TRUE
  ),
  Contemporaneous = format_adjacency_matrix(
    full_matrices$contemporaneous, p_matrices$contemporaneous,
    diagonal_defined = FALSE
  ),
  Between_Person = format_adjacency_matrix(
    full_matrices$between, p_matrices$between, diagonal_defined = FALSE
  )
)
for (network in names(star_matrices)) {
  dimnames(star_matrices[[network]]) <- list(visual_labels, visual_labels)
}

matrix_to_sheet <- function(matrix) {
  output <- data.frame(Node = rownames(matrix), matrix, check.names = FALSE)
  rownames(output) <- NULL

}

    "Rows are source nodes at t-1; columns are outcome nodes at t"

)

valid_formatted_cells <- function(matrix, diagonal_defined) {
  cells <- if (diagonal_defined) {
    as.vector(matrix)
  } else {
    matrix[row(matrix) != col(matrix)]
  }
  all(grepl("^-?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]{3}(\\*{1,3})?$", cells))
}

star_rule_valid <- function(stars, p) {
  all(stars[is.finite(p) & p < .001] == "***") &&
    all(stars[is.finite(p) & p >= .001 & p < .01] == "**") &&
    all(stars[is.finite(p) & p >= .01 & p < .05] == "*") &&
    all(stars[is.finite(p) & p >= .05] == "")
}
```

# Edge-weight heatmaps

Each heatmap uses a separate within-network color scale. Only supported
raw-`p < .05` cells receive color. Nonsignificant and undefined cells are
explicitly white, and no cell contains a text label.

```{r heatmaps, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
heatmap_titles <- c(
  temporal = "Temporal edge weights",
  contemporaneous = "Contemporaneous edge weights",
  between = "Between-person edge weights"
)

make_heatmap_data <- function(network) {
  weight <- full_matrices[[network]]
  p <- p_matrices[[network]]
  supported <- is.finite(p) & p < .05
  if (network != "temporal") diag(supported) <- FALSE
  display_weight <- weight
  display_weight[!supported] <- NA_real_
  grid <- expand.grid(
    row_index = seq_along(visual_labels),
    column_index = seq_along(visual_labels)
  )
  grid$row_label <- factor(
    visual_labels[grid$row_index], levels = rev(visual_labels)
  )
  grid$column_label <- factor(
    visual_labels[grid$column_index], levels = visual_labels
  )
  grid$weight <- display_weight[cbind(grid$row_index, grid$column_index)]
  grid$supported <- supported[cbind(grid$row_index, grid$column_index)]
  grid
}

make_heatmap_plot <- function(network) {
  data <- make_heatmap_data(network)
  max_abs <- max(abs(data$weight), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_abs) || max_abs <= 0) max_abs <- 1
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    data,
    ggplot2::aes(x = column_label, y = row_label, fill = weight)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "#D9D9D9", linewidth = 0.35) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(3.5, 9.5), color = "#606060", linewidth = 0.65
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(3.5, 9.5), color = "#606060", linewidth = 0.65
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166AC", mid = "#FFFFFF", high = "#B2182B",
      midpoint = 0, limits = c(-max_abs, max_abs),
      na.value = "#FFFFFF", name = "Edge weight"
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_fixed() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = heatmap_titles[[network]],
      subtitle = paste(
        "Colored cells: unadjusted p < .05; white cells: nonsignificant",
        if (network == "temporal")
          "| rows = source at t-1, columns = outcome at t" else "| AND rule"
      ),
      x = if (network == "temporal") "Outcome node at t" else "Node",
      y = if (network == "temporal") "Source node at t-1" else "Node"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", color = "#202020"),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#4A4A4A"),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#202020"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  attr(plot, "scale_max_abs") <- max_abs
  plot
}

heatmap_plots <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(c("temporal", "contemporaneous", "between"), make_heatmap_plot),
  c("Temporal", "Contemporaneous", "Between")
)

for (network in names(heatmap_plots)) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = heatmap_files[[network]], plot = heatmap_plots[[network]],
    width = heatmap_canvas[["width"]], height = heatmap_canvas[["height"]],
    units = "in", bg = "white"
  )
}

)
```

```{r validate-figures}
positive_color_expected <- c(
  vapply(network_specifications, function(x) any(x$matrix > 0), logical(1)),
  Combined = any(vapply(sparse_matrices, function(x) any(x > 0), logical(1)))
)
negative_color_expected <- c(
  vapply(network_specifications, function(x) any(x$matrix < 0), logical(1)),
  Combined = any(vapply(sparse_matrices, function(x) any(x < 0), logical(1)))
)

figure_audit <- data.frame(
  network = names(figure_files),
  svg_file = basename(figure_files),
  svg_bytes = as.numeric(file.info(figure_files)$size),
  svg_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(figure_files)),
  positive_color_expected = unname(positive_color_expected[names(figure_files)]),
  positive_color_present = vapply(
    svg_text, function(x) grepl("#E64B35", x, fixed = TRUE), logical(1)
  ),
  negative_color_expected = unname(negative_color_expected[names(figure_files)]),
  negative_color_present = vapply(
    svg_text, function(x) grepl("#4DBBD5", x, fixed = TRUE), logical(1)
  ),
  edge_weight_text_present = vapply(
    svg_text_elements,
    function(x) grepl("[+-][0-9]+\\.[0-9]{3}", x),
    logical(1)
  ),
  saved_by_qgraph_native = TRUE,
  saved_by_ggsave = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

network_display_audit <- data.frame(
  network = c("Temporal", "TemporalWithAR", "Contemporaneous", "Between"),
  displayed_edges = c(
    nrow(display_edge_tables$temporal_nonself),
    nrow(display_edge_tables$temporal_nonself) +
      nrow(display_edge_tables$temporal_self),
    nrow(display_edge_tables$contemporaneous),
    nrow(display_edge_tables$between)
  ),
  autoregressive_self_loops = c(
    0L, nrow(display_edge_tables$temporal_self), 0L, 0L
  ),
  edge_weight_labels = 0L,
  arrow_size = c(
    individual_temporal_arrow_size,
    individual_temporal_arrow_size,
    NA_real_, NA_real_
  ),
  combined_temporal_arrow_size = c(
    combined_temporal_arrow_size,
    combined_temporal_arrow_size,
    NA_real_, NA_real_
  ),
  edge_curve = c(
    temporal_edge_curve, temporal_edge_curve, 0, 0
  ),
  curve_all_edges = c(
    temporal_curve_all, temporal_curve_all, FALSE, FALSE
  ),
  individual_canvas_width_inches = individual_canvas[["width"]],
  individual_canvas_height_inches = individual_canvas[["height"]],
  individual_node_size = individual_node_size,
  edge_width_rule = "constant",
  edge_width = edge_encoding_audit$minimum_edge_width,
  edge_width_range = edge_encoding_audit$maximum_edge_width -
    edge_encoding_audit$minimum_edge_width,
  weight_encoding = "within-network linear transparency",
  minimum_transparency = edge_encoding_audit$minimum_transparency,
  maximum_transparency = edge_encoding_audit$maximum_transparency,
  transparency_monotonic = edge_encoding_audit$transparency_monotonic,
  node_shape = node_indicator_audit$node_shape,
  equal_node_width_height = node_indicator_audit$equal_width_height,
  outer_ring_metric = node_indicator_audit$ring_metric,
  outer_ring_scaling = node_indicator_audit$ring_scaling,
  outer_ring_fraction_minimum =
    node_indicator_audit$display_fraction_minimum,
  outer_ring_fraction_maximum =
    node_indicator_audit$display_fraction_maximum,
  outer_ring_matches_metric =
    node_indicator_audit$qgraph_pie_matches_specification,
  identical_layout = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  all(figure_audit$svg_bytes > 1000),
  all(figure_audit$positive_color_present == figure_audit$positive_color_expected),
  all(figure_audit$negative_color_present == figure_audit$negative_color_expected),
  !any(figure_audit$edge_weight_text_present),
  all(figure_audit$saved_by_qgraph_native),
  !any(figure_audit$saved_by_ggsave),
  all(network_display_audit$edge_weight_labels == 0L),
  all(network_display_audit$edge_width_rule == "constant"),
  all(abs(network_display_audit$edge_width - constant_edge_width) < 1e-10),
  all(abs(network_display_audit$edge_width_range) < 1e-10),
  all(network_display_audit$minimum_transparency <= 1 / 255 + 1e-10),
  all(abs(
    network_display_audit$maximum_transparency - maximum_edge_transparency
  ) <= 1 / 255 + 1e-10),
  all(network_display_audit$transparency_monotonic),
  all(network_display_audit$node_shape == "circle"),
  all(network_display_audit$equal_node_width_height),
  all(network_display_audit$outer_ring_matches_metric),
  all(network_display_audit$outer_ring_fraction_minimum >= 0),
  all(network_display_audit$outer_ring_fraction_maximum <= 1),
  all(network_display_audit$arrow_size[
    network_display_audit$network %in% c("Temporal", "TemporalWithAR")
  ] <= 2.0),
  all(network_display_audit$combined_temporal_arrow_size[
    network_display_audit$network %in% c("Temporal", "TemporalWithAR")
  ] > network_display_audit$arrow_size[
    network_display_audit$network %in% c("Temporal", "TemporalWithAR")
  ]),
  all(network_display_audit$curve_all_edges[
    network_display_audit$network %in% c("Temporal", "TemporalWithAR")
  ]),
  all(abs(network_display_audit$edge_curve[
    network_display_audit$network %in% c("Temporal", "TemporalWithAR")
  ] - temporal_edge_curve) < 1e-10),
  all(abs(network_display_audit$edge_curve[
    network_display_audit$network %in% c("Contemporaneous", "Between")
  ]) < 1e-10),
  all(network_display_audit$individual_canvas_width_inches > 9.8),
  all(network_display_audit$individual_canvas_height_inches > 8.2),
  all(network_display_audit$individual_node_size < 6.4),
  network_display_audit$autoregressive_self_loops[
    network_display_audit$network == "Temporal"
  ] == 0L,
  network_display_audit$autoregressive_self_loops[
    network_display_audit$network == "TemporalWithAR"
  ] == nrow(display_edge_tables$temporal_self),
  all(network_display_audit$identical_layout)
)

knitr::kable(figure_audit)
knitr::kable(network_display_audit)
```

```{r validate-rendered-artifacts, include=FALSE}
s5_4_acceptance <- data.frame(
  criterion = c(
    "qgraph natively renders four accepted sparse network variants",
    "All qgraph built-in layouts audited on no-autoregression Temporal",
    "Selected Temporal spring coordinates reused identically by all networks",
    "Visualization labels use E1-E3, P1-P6, and D1-D3",
    "Every qgraph node is an equal-width equal-height circle",
    paste(
      "Outer rings show temporal R2 or maximum-scaled full-network",
      "strength with exact qgraph pie fractions"
    ),
    "Individual canvases are enlarged and individual nodes are reduced",
    "Primary Temporal omits self-loops and companion Temporal retains them",
    "Only S5.3 unadjusted p < .05 edges are drawn",
    "Every displayed positive/negative edge uses the locked sign color",
    paste(
      "All edges use constant width and within-network transparency encodes",
      "absolute weight from 0 to 0.75"
    ),
    "No network figure contains edge-weight text labels",
    "Temporal arrowheads use the reduced size",
    "Combined-panel Temporal arrowheads are enlarged for print legibility",
    "Every Temporal directed edge is curved while undirected edges remain straight",
    "Temporal arrows and undirected contemporaneous/between edges",
    "Five canonical network SVGs written from native qgraph",
    "Full adjacency workbook uses three decimals and raw-p significance stars",
    "Three no-text heatmaps use E-P-D order and white nonsignificant cells",
    "Sole figure-provenance RDA reload"
  ),
  passed = c(
    all(qgraph_audit$object_class == "qgraph") &&
      all(qgraph_audit$graph_engine == "qgraph native base graphics") &&
      !any(qgraph_audit$ggplot_network_geometry),
    identical(layout_selection_audit$algorithm, c("circle", "groups", "spring")) &&
      all(file.exists(layout_candidate_files)) &&
      identical(
        layout_selection_audit$algorithm[layout_selection_audit$selected],
        "spring"
      ),
    all(network_display_audit$identical_layout) &&
      all(qgraph_audit$layout_algorithm == "spring"),
    identical(
      layout_data$visual_label,
      c(paste0("E", 1:3), paste0("P", 1:6), paste0("D", 1:3))
    ),
    all(node_indicator_audit$node_shape == "circle") &&
      all(node_indicator_audit$equal_width_height) &&
      all(qgraph_audit$node_shape == "circle") &&
      all(qgraph_audit$node_width_equals_height),
    identical(
      node_indicator_audit$ring_metric,
      c(
        "Temporal nodewise R2", "Temporal nodewise R2",
        "Full-network strength", "Full-network strength"
      )
    ) &&
      all(node_indicator_audit$qgraph_pie_matches_specification) &&
      all(node_indicator_audit$display_fraction_minimum >= 0) &&
      all(node_indicator_audit$display_fraction_maximum <= 1) &&
      max(node_indicator_values$display_fraction[
        node_indicator_values$network == "Contemporaneous"
      ]) == 1 &&
      max(node_indicator_values$display_fraction[
        node_indicator_values$network == "Between"
      ]) == 1,
    individual_canvas[["width"]] > 9.8 &&
      individual_canvas[["height"]] > 8.2 &&
      individual_node_size < 6.4 &&
      all(node_indicator_audit$node_width == individual_node_size) &&
      all(node_indicator_audit$node_height == individual_node_size),
    all(diag(network_specifications$Temporal$matrix) == 0) &&
      all(diag(network_specifications$TemporalWithAR$matrix) != 0) &&
      network_display_audit$autoregressive_self_loops[
        network_display_audit$network == "Temporal"
      ] == 0L &&
      network_display_audit$autoregressive_self_loops[
        network_display_audit$network == "TemporalWithAR"
      ] == 12L,
    identical(
      unname(network_display_audit$displayed_edges),
      c(
        sum(edge_tables$temporal$supported_p05 & !edge_tables$temporal$self_loop),
        sum(edge_tables$temporal$supported_p05),
        sum(edge_tables$contemporaneous$supported_p05),
        sum(edge_tables$between$supported_p05)
      )
    ),
    all(figure_audit$positive_color_present == figure_audit$positive_color_expected) &&
      all(figure_audit$negative_color_present == figure_audit$negative_color_expected),
    all(network_display_audit$edge_width_rule == "constant") &&
      all(abs(network_display_audit$edge_width - constant_edge_width) < 1e-10) &&
      all(abs(network_display_audit$edge_width_range) < 1e-10) &&
      all(network_display_audit$minimum_transparency <= 1 / 255 + 1e-10) &&
      all(abs(
        network_display_audit$maximum_transparency - maximum_edge_transparency
      ) <= 1 / 255 + 1e-10) &&
      all(network_display_audit$transparency_monotonic) &&
      all(!qgraph_audit$qgraph_weighted_width_scaling),
    all(network_display_audit$edge_weight_labels == 0L) &&
      !any(figure_audit$edge_weight_text_present) &&
      !any(qgraph_audit$edge_weight_labels),
    all(network_display_audit$arrow_size[
      network_display_audit$network %in% c("Temporal", "TemporalWithAR")
    ] <= 2.0),
    combined_temporal_arrow_size > individual_temporal_arrow_size &&
      all(network_display_audit$combined_temporal_arrow_size[
        network_display_audit$network %in% c("Temporal", "TemporalWithAR")
      ] == combined_temporal_arrow_size),
    all(qgraph_audit$curve_all_edges[
      qgraph_audit$network %in% c("Temporal", "TemporalWithAR")
    ]) &&
      all(abs(qgraph_audit$actual_minimum_abs_curve[
        qgraph_audit$network %in% c("Temporal", "TemporalWithAR")
      ] - temporal_edge_curve) < 1e-10) &&
      all(abs(qgraph_audit$actual_maximum_abs_curve[
        qgraph_audit$network %in% c("Contemporaneous", "Between")
      ]) < 1e-10),
    network_specifications$Temporal$directed &&
      network_specifications$TemporalWithAR$directed &&
      !network_specifications$Contemporaneous$directed &&
      !network_specifications$Between$directed,
    all(file.exists(all_figure_files)) &&
      all(figure_audit$saved_by_qgraph_native) &&
      !any(figure_audit$saved_by_ggsave),
    file.exists(table_file) &&
      workbook_audit$three_decimal_cells &&
      workbook_audit$significance_stars &&
      workbook_audit$ordered_E_P_D &&
      workbook_audit$undefined_diagonal_NA &&
      workbook_audit$formula_errors == 0L,
    all(file.exists(heatmap_files)) &&
      !any(heatmap_audit$cell_text) &&
      all(heatmap_audit$nonsignificant_color == "#FFFFFF") &&
      all(heatmap_audit$nonsignificant_cells_masked) &&
      all(heatmap_audit$row_column_order == "E1-E3, P1-P6, D1-D3") &&
      all(heatmap_audit$saved_by_ggsave),
    file.exists(result_file)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(all(s5_4_acceptance$passed))
```
